headline: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia reduces stake in Carysil in Q2
summary: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia has trimmed his stake in kitchen sink maker Carysil by over 2 lakh shares during the July-September quarter, bringing his holding down to 2.72%. The stock has corrected sharply from its July peak following a strong rally earlier this year. Retail investors tracking ace investor portfolio movements should note the reduction in holding amid the stock's recent correction.
why_it_matters: Ace investor stake reduction may weigh on retail sentiment.
